## Next Steps

1. Start the v2 API server:
   ```bash
   cd repos/metabob-activity-api
   export SURREALDB_URL=http://localhost:8000
   export REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379
   bun run dev
   ```

2. Set up port forwarding for Kubernetes services:
   ```bash
   kubectl port-forward -n metabob svc/surrealdb 8000:8000 &
   kubectl port-forward -n metabob svc/redis-master 6379:6379 &
   ```

3. Re-run validation harness:
   ```bash
   bun run tests/validation-harnesses/v2-api-impulse-endpoints-harness.ts
   ```

Test Case 1: POST /v2/impulses - Create Impulse with Project Scope

Input:
  endpoint: POST /v2/impulses
  headers: { Authorization: Bearer {token}, Content-Type: application/json }
  body: {
    impulse_id: 'test-impulse-001',
    project_id: 'project-impulse-create',
    impulse_data: {
      id: 'test-impulse-001',
      type: 'testResults',
      pointer: { type: 'memo', content: 'Test impulse content', source: 'harness' },
      budget: 2000,
      priority: 1,
      scope: 'session',
      metadata: { test: true }
    }
  }

Expected Output:
  status: 201
  response: {
    impulse_id: 'test-impulse-001',
    api_key: string,
    project_id: 'project-impulse-create',
    impulse_data: {...},
    created_at: ISO8601 timestamp,
    updated_at: ISO8601 timestamp
  }
  surrealdb: Record exists in impulse_data table with composite key (api_key, project_id, impulse_id)
results.reason: Validation harness requires running API server at http://localhost:8080. Infrastructure (SurrealDB, Redis) is available in Kubernetes but API server needs to be started.
